6.2.basis: escalation clause: 2 distinct verified half-point measures

7.1.basis: Singapore has a horizontal, economy-wide statute—the Personal Data Protection Act 2012, s.3—establishing general rules for the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data across sectors, indicating a comprehensive rather than absent or merely sectoral framework.

7.2.basis: Singapore has a dedicated, horizontally-applicable cybersecurity statute (Cybersecurity Act 2018, s.5(1) establishing the Commissioner's functions/oversight), further expanded by the Cybersecurity (Amendment) Act 2024 covering CII, entities of special cybersecurity interest, and foundational digital infrastructure providers. The rejected candidates confirm the Act's existence and broad scope (definitions, designation, enforcement, penalties) even though those specific provisions were rejected as merely procedural/penal rather than independently dispositive. Collectively this shows a comprehensive dedicated framework exists, so the economy does not lack one.
